title: Signed dictators are always accepted
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be a coordinate, and choose whether to negate its sign. The three-way ranking test accepts the signed dictator that outputs this coordinate, with the chosen negation, with probability $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean choice of whether to negate the dictator
